title: Daily briefing: The big push to personalize psychiatry
title_zh: 每日简报：推进精神病学个性化的大力行动
abstract: A data-driven approach could match treatments to individuals with more precision. Plus, funders in Europe are backing preprint-led publishing and whether professors should care about student evaluations.
abstract_zh: 一种数据驱动的方法可能更精确地将治疗与个体匹配。此外，欧洲资助方正在支持先行出版物引领的出版，以及教授们是否应在意学生评教。
snippet: A data-driven approach could match treatments to individuals with more precision. Plus, funders in Europe are backing preprint-led publishing and whether professors should care about student evaluations.
